# Week 4: Data and async

**Goal:** Fetch, cache and protect data: HttpClient, httpResource, interceptors, guards, resolvers and the RxJS you still need.

About 10 hours. Do the steps in order; skip steps marked for the other track.

## 1. Read: [HTTP client guide: requests, interceptors, HttpContext](https://angular.dev/guide/http)

- [ ] Done · Both tracks · about 60 min
- Concepts: HttpClient and httpResource, HTTP interceptors

## 2. Read: [Reactive data fetching with httpResource](https://angular.dev/guide/http/http-resource)

- [ ] Done · Both tracks · about 30 min
- Concepts: HttpClient and httpResource, Signals: signal, computed, effect, linkedSignal, resource

## 3. Read: [Async reactivity with resource()](https://angular.dev/guide/signals/resource)

- [ ] Done · Both tracks · about 30 min
- Concepts: Signals: signal, computed, effect, linkedSignal, resource

## 4. Read: [Routing guide: guards and resolvers sections](https://angular.dev/guide/routing)

- [ ] Done · Both tracks · about 40 min
- Concepts: Guards and resolvers

## 5. Watch: [Angular: RxJS for Reactive Programming by Deborah Kurata (Pluralsight)](https://www.pluralsight.com/courses/angular-rxjs-reactive-programming)

- [ ] Done · Both tracks · about 90 min
- No course licence? Watch the matching topics on the official Angular YouTube channel instead.
- Concepts: RxJS essentials

## 6. Explore in the app: Product list: URL-driven state and debounced search

- [ ] Done · Both tracks · about 60 min
- Open in the running app: `http://localhost:4200/products`
- Files: [`src/app/features/products/product-list/product-list.ts`](../../src/app/features/products/product-list/product-list.ts), [`src/app/features/products/product-list/product-list.html`](../../src/app/features/products/product-list/product-list.html), [`src/app/core/services/product.service.ts`](../../src/app/core/services/product.service.ts)
- Look for: Query params bound to inputs, linkedSignal for the search box, toObservable + debounceTime, httpResource re-fetching, error() checked before value().
- Concepts: HttpClient and httpResource, Routing and lazy loading, RxJS essentials

## 7. Study the code: The three interceptors

- [ ] Done · Both tracks · about 45 min
- Files: [`src/app/app.config.ts`](../../src/app/app.config.ts), [`src/app/core/interceptors/loading.interceptor.ts`](../../src/app/core/interceptors/loading.interceptor.ts), [`src/app/core/interceptors/auth.interceptor.ts`](../../src/app/core/interceptors/auth.interceptor.ts), [`src/app/core/interceptors/error.interceptor.ts`](../../src/app/core/interceptors/error.interceptor.ts)
- Look for: Order of execution, req.clone(), HttpContextToken opt-outs, tokens sent only to our API host, errors re-thrown.
- Concepts: HTTP interceptors

## 8. Study the code: Guards and the resolver

- [ ] Done · Both tracks · about 40 min
- Open in the running app: `http://localhost:4200/account`
- Files: [`src/app/core/guards/auth.guard.ts`](../../src/app/core/guards/auth.guard.ts), [`src/app/core/guards/unsaved-changes.guard.ts`](../../src/app/core/guards/unsaved-changes.guard.ts), [`src/app/core/resolvers/product.resolver.ts`](../../src/app/core/resolvers/product.resolver.ts)
- Look for: canMatch vs canActivate, guard factories, returning UrlTree or RedirectCommand, resolved data arriving as an input.
- Concepts: Guards and resolvers, Routing and lazy loading

## 9. Exercise: Add /categories/:slug using router input binding and httpResource, with a retry button on error

- [ ] Done · Foundations only · about 180 min
- Files: [`src/app/app.routes.ts`](../../src/app/app.routes.ts), [`src/app/features/products/`](../../src/app/features/products/)
- Concepts: HttpClient and httpResource, Routing and lazy loading

## 10. Exercise: Add a caching interceptor driven by an HttpContextToken and a refresh-token flow using /auth/refresh

- [ ] Done · Accelerated only · about 300 min
- Files: [`src/app/core/interceptors/`](../../src/app/core/interceptors/), [`src/app/core/services/auth.service.ts`](../../src/app/core/services/auth.service.ts)
- Concepts: HTTP interceptors, HttpClient and httpResource, RxJS essentials

## 11. Self-check: Self-check: answer without looking

- [ ] Done · Both tracks · about 15 min
  1. What happens to an in-flight httpResource request when its params change?
  2. A request passes loading → auth → error interceptors. In what order do they see the response?
  3. Why does /admin use canMatch rather than canActivate?
